integrity.claim_scope: One complete cuboctahedral excitation temporal and geometric-orbit census.
integrity.evidence: Complete state-map enumeration by C++17 plus a separate whole-space Python/NumPy implementation; exact automorphism orbit computation.
integrity.prior_work_acknowledgment: Original excitation rule, general activity theorem, graph identity and graph automorphism order predate the present exact census.

scientific_limitations: Exact finite census applies only to the twelve-vertex cuboctahedral graph and the specified threshold-one three-state rule.
Exhaustive finite-state calculations do not imply an infinite-family theorem.
Historical priority may be affected by unindexed equivalent finite classifications.
No independent external mathematical audit has been carried out.
